assertions.description: navigator.mediaCapabilities is exposed, so IAMF configurations can be queried at all.
MediaSource.isTypeSupported() is callable — MSE is the surface IAMF decoding ships on.
decodingInfo() resolves with a boolean supported field for a plain AAC-LC audio/mp4 media-source query — proving the audio probe path works so a negative IAMF answer is trustworthy.
assertions.test: navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', audio: { contentType: 'audio/mp4; codecs="mp4a.40.2"', channels: '2', bitrate: 128000, samplerate: 48000 } }).then((i) => typeof i.supported === 'boolean')

assertions.description: A spec-valid IAMF codec string (iamf.000.000.Opus, spec section 6.4) is a well-formed configuration: decodingInfo() must RESOLVE with a boolean supported answer — supported:false on a browser without IAMF decoding is a pass; only a rejection fails.
assertions.test: navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', audio: { contentType: 'audio/mp4; codecs="iamf.000.000.Opus"', channels: '2', bitrate: 128000, samplerate: 48000 } }).then((i) => typeof i.supported === 'boolean')

assertions.description: MediaSource.isTypeSupported() and decodingInfo({type:'media-source'}).supported give the same yes/no for iamf.000.000.Opus — the two MSE-facing capability doors must not contradict each other, whichever answer this browser gives.
assertions.test: (async () => { const t = 'audio/mp4; codecs="iamf.000.000.Opus"'; const its = MediaSource.isTypeSupported(t); const di = await navigator.mediaCapabilities.decodingInfo({ type: 'media-source', audio: { contentType: t, channels: '2', bitrate: 128000, samplerate: 48000 } }); return its === di.supported; })()

assertions.description: HTMLMediaElement.canPlayType() for the IAMF content type answers with the spec vocabulary — exactly '' , 'maybe', or 'probably' — never another string and never a throw.
assertions.test: (() => { const v = document.createElement('audio').canPlayType('audio/mp4; codecs="iamf.000.000.Opus"'); return v === '' || v === 'maybe' || v === 'probably'; })()

assertions.description: Spec section 6.4 requires exactly three decimal digits per profile element: iamf.0.0.Opus and out-of-range iamf.999.000.Opus must never be claimed supported by isTypeSupported() — on any browser, including one that decodes IAMF.
The substream codec element must be one of Opus / mp4a.40.2 / fLaC / ipcm: a foreign codec (iamf.000.000.ec-3) and a non-AAC-LC mp4a variant (iamf.000.000.mp4a.40.5) must never be claimed supported.
